summary: A tightly controlled bureaucratic two-hander that lands the b6 beat and the tp2 turn on solid concrete detail, undercut by one ungrounded sightline into the desk drawer.

issues.unit: P27: "Stettler erkannte seine eigene Rückseite, die Schrift der Nacht"
issues.fix_hint: Add a clause establishing how Stettler, seated across the desk, can see into the drawer Rieder opens on his own side well enough to identify handwriting inside it — e.g. Rieder tilts it toward him, sets it on the desk, or Stettler leans in — the way P22 explicitly grounds his sightline to the window.
